channel.title: Morning Mail
channel.description: Stay updated on the latest news and events happening in the RPI community.

item.title: ISSS Town Hall: Duration of Status (D/S) Changes
item.description: ISSS is holding a Town Hall to share information about the recent regulatory change to Duration of Status (D/S) that affects individuals in F-1 and J-1 status and their dependents. This event is open to the campus community, and this session focus is on answering graduate student questions. Join us in-person on Tuesday, September 1, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. in the Academy Hall Auditorium, Room 3500. The RPI ID card is required to access the building.

item.title: Have you updated your local Address?
item.description: Date: Thursday, August 27, 2026 (all day) - If you are living off campus this semester, please make sure your local address is up to date in the student information system (SIS). Keeping your local address current helps RPI communicate important information and provide support when needed.

item.title: Sign Up for Orchestra, Choir, and Wind Symphony Auditions
item.description: OPEN TO ALL STUDENTS, FACULTY, AND STAFF! Do you play an instrument or sing? Are you interested in joining one of RPI’s musical ensembles? Join us for Ensemble Auditions Mon. August 24th - Sat. August 29th. Please sign up for an audition time on our website. Please reach out to Dr. Robert Whalen, whaler2@rpi.edu, with any questions about the audition process. We look forward to welcoming you!

item.title: Seeking a Highly Motivated RPI Undergraduate or Master’s Student to Join a Research Project
item.description: We are seeking a highly motivated RPI undergraduate or master’s student to join a research project focused on developing optimization methods for collaborative school transportation planning. The position is available as a paid hourly research assistantship or for academic credit, depending on the student’s interests and eligibility. item.title: Upcoming Brief Carousel Signage Outages
item.description: Carousel Signage has notified RPI of two upcoming outages of the Carousel Signage website. During this time all signage will continue to play cached content, however the website will be unavailable briefly for a 10 minute period while the site is updated. Outage 1 - Tuesday August 18 at 5:30pm Outage 2 - Tuesday August 25 between 8pm and 10pm

item.title: Houston Field House Scheduled Power Shutdown – August 27
item.description: A scheduled power shutdown will occur at the Houston Field House beginning at 7:00 a.m. on Thursday, August 27, 2026, to accommodate necessary electrical work. During the shutdown, the building will operate on limited backup generator power for the remainder of the day while the work is completed. Some building systems and services may be temporarily unavailable or affected during this time.
item.author: Community

item.title: 2026 Founders Award of Excellence Nominations Due
item.description: Date: Saturday, August 29, 2026 (all day) - The Founders Award of Excellence was established in 1994 to honor students who embody the qualities of creativity, discovery, and leadership, and the values of pride and responsibility. The award includes a cash prize, a special certificate, and recognition by faculty, staff, and peers at the Honors Convocation ceremony. Nominations should be submitted via our Qualtrics Form (available in link) no later than Saturday, August 29.
item.author: Faculty and Staff

item.title: All Instructors - Changes for Submitting a LMS Fall 2026 Course Request
item.description:
Note - Please read the entire announcement as there are changes in submitting a request due to moving to Ultra Course View. You can find Ultra Videos and documentation on our LMS support site. Instructor’s can now copy your own content from a previous semester’s course, that’s still on the LMS, into your current semester’s course, as long as you were/are the instructor in both semester courses.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
